note:
T3 item 1 (MEASURED, float64; exact identities checked separately in t3_exact.py): cone counts and gaps of the
natural family. Runs on box B: python t3_item1.py [nproc]  ->  item1.json

Members (all periods are palindromic: phases exp(-+i Omega), each twice; Omega per period of two ticks):
  W2      CF-1 period (half-step frame)
  B(phi)  Wilson-type lazy sub-steps B_i = M(-phi/2) L_i(phi) M(-phi/2)          (parity mixing; full zone)
  C(tau)  Wilson step from public reflectors N_i = S_i^-1 M(tau) S_i M(-tau)     (parity preserving; reduced zone)
